description: This Java class 'DefaultAcknowledgementConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'AcknowledgementConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration parameters related to acknowledgement handling, such as timeouts and maximum bytes, loaded from a configuration source.

classes.name: DefaultAcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing AcknowledgementConfig, encapsulating acknowledgement-related configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAcknowledgementConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the fallback timeout duration for the forwarder.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the fallback lifetime duration for the collector.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the ask timeout duration for the collector fallback.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes issued.
